turns.question: Which call topic had the highest objection rate in September 2026, and what was that rate?
turns.answer: The call topic with the highest objection rate in September 2026 (1-30 September) was returns, at 72.7% (model-derived, from gemini-3.5-flash labels); product followed at 50.0%, and delivery and pricing had no rate (no labelled calls in that period).
